scope.admission: Exact driver-owned turn/claim/step/request/planned tool input/context and cleanup phases, module-private dispatch through actual Agent constructor binding
scope.context: After actual tool/result commit; exact slot execution/result/context, synchronous active once-only original inbox.splice publisher
scope.private: Module WeakMap keyed by immutable runtime holder; per-Agent callbacks module-private; no exposed invoke/dispatch capability or new public event
scope.free: No require/provider retains original Free driver execution, cold restoration and context publication
scope.cleanup: step-end/turn-end continue when required provider missing; original committed receipt is not undone by post-commit policy failure
limitations: Fresh constructor/fork seeds are not covered; cold restore is a checkpoint only, not durable authorization. The deployment provider must verify its signed checkpoint and persisted work.
ToolRuntime final body admission is separate; this only attests exact Loop-planned input before scheduler.prepare
A context policy that throws/returns Promise after sync publication cannot roll back that accepted write
Public events remain observation-only and cannot call private policy; this is not protection against arbitrary mutation of SDK private internals

Rejection before migration admission leaves every historical log byte unchanged; revocation after an authorized migration or append cannot roll back committed generations, closers or later setup/publication writes, but prevents restored work from reaching the model.

Input checkpoint attests the persisted pre-claim prefix only. Provider must durably commit its acceptance ledger and govern cold recovery; in-flight tool side effects and reentrant failure after a committed partial Inbox splice need separate reconciliation.
scope.restore: SessionPersistence.openWithAdmission read-only preparation under retained writer/OS ownership before migration; exact frozen validated header/events, inherited count and official fused signal; abortable async policy returning a frozen synchronous assertCurrent lease; checked before first closer write, construction, setup/commit/publication awaits and final pending wake
scope.restoreCleanup: Private pending-restore state preserves the durable Inbox on failed or cancelled admission-enabled restoration, including owner/factory disposal; successful activation removes that state, so subsequent user disposal and unguarded Free cleanup retain original cancellation semantics.
scope.restoreWrites: Admission-enabled restore passes the official fused signal to closer and both seed/setup suffix appends and races their waits. Cancellation abandons adapter continuations; the owning lifecycle still awaits the original handle.close(), including any in-flight backend mutation chain. Committed writes are not rolled back; unguarded Free and fresh/fork appends retain their original waits.
scope.inputCheckpoint: Before Inbox removal: official SessionStore live drain, owned writer flush/read and exact frozen prefix; async once-installed private policy plus frozen synchronous lease; waiting appends remain queued outside the selected batch; cancellation/rejection does not claim pending input. No handle or replay dispatcher is exposed.
scope.progressCheckpoint: Factory-owned flush/read snapshots after claim, before model and tool dispatch, and before step/turn cleanup; private once-installed async policy with exact synchronous lease. No-policy Free has no added IO or await.
scope.inputShutdown: An enabled durable input checkpoint retains unclaimed Inbox during owner/factory disposal. Explicit user cancellation and unguarded Free retain their original semantics.
scope.restoreWake: Optional frozen lease own data wakePending:true requests the existing driver only after final restore admission, publication and temporary owner release; absent preserves idle and original latched-wake semantics. Invalid getter or values fail before restore writes.
scope.restoreBinding: Module-private restore-publish descriptor after actual Session/Agent enter and before either public creation notification; deployment binds verified cold roots once here. Public events cannot invoke this descriptor or consume the proof.
scope.inboxProjection: The root package exports the original standard Inbox projection object already registered by AgentLoop; maintenance can register and cold-fold it without Agent, Loop, model, tool or work-admission construction. No duplicate fold, mutation command or execution authority is introduced.
